name: Ninemile Lake Campground
note: Superior NF campground on ~300-acre Ninemile Lake, NE of Finland; 26 sites (13 FCFS, 13 reservable), back-in, no hookups, solar-pump water, vault toilets, boat ramp; most sites fit small RVs under ~24 ft (marginal for a 23-ft rig). --Claude

name: Pfeiffer Lake Campground
note: Superior NF campground on Pfeiffer Lake (LaCroix district near Cook); 16 drive-in sites (8 reservable, 8 FCFS) with several fitting RVs to 32 ft, no hookups, drinking water, vault toilets, grassy swim beach + fishing dock; also a few hike/paddle backcountry sites. --Claude

name: Poplar River Rustic Campground
note: Tiny rustic Superior NF campground (~4 sites) on the Poplar River along the Honeymoon Trail (FR 164) between Tofte and Lutsen; FCFS, no hookups/water/garbage, vault toilet; several sites have direct river access. Drive-in car camping; max RV length not posted (small/rustic - verify fit). --Claude

name: Silver Island Lake Rustic Campground
note: Rustic Superior NF campground on Silver Island Lake; 8 drive-in sites suitable for smaller RVs (longer rigs struggle to find level ground - marginal for a 23-ft rig) plus 3 boat-in backcountry sites; FCFS, vault toilet, no potable water, boat launch. Not on recreation.gov - FCFS. --Claude

name: Tamarack Point Campground
note: Chippewa NF campground on Tamarack Point jutting into Lake Winnibigoshish, ~13 mi N of Deer River then FR 2163. 31 drive-in sites for tents/trailers, no hookups, vault toilets, drinking water, boat access/docks. First-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov). Short season (~May 1 to just after July 4). --Claude

name: Williams Narrows Campground
note: Chippewa NF campground on the E shore of Cut Foot Sioux Lake (next to Lake Winnibigoshish). 17 single-unit sites in birch/oak/pine over upper and lower loops, boat landing + swimming beach between loops; no potable water. Reservable online (sites go FCFS inside 4 days). --Claude

name: Cavens Landing Campground
note: Small rustic campground on the west shore of Fox Lake ~2 mi N of Sherburn (Martin County); 17 sites with sewer + 30/50-amp electric, 4 lakeside sites with dock options; docks/kayaks/bikes for guest use. FCFS - call to confirm availability; daily/weekly/seasonal/year-round. --Claude

name: Falls Stay N Play
note: Family fun-park campground on Hwy 59 N at Thief River Falls (est. 2010); ~75 full-hookup sites, big-rig/pull-through, restrooms/showers, laundry, plus go-kart track, 18-hole mini-golf, arcade. FCFS - no reservations needed. --Claude

name: North Star Campground (Chippewa National Forest)
note: USFS Chippewa National Forest campground on North Star Lake; 38 nonelectric drive-in tent/RV sites (no length restriction listed) near a sandy swim beach, vault toilets, no hookups. Sites 1-21 FCFS; sites 22-38 reservable on recreation.gov in summer. --Claude

name: Stony Point Campground (Chippewa National Forest)
note: Chippewa National Forest (USFS) campground on Leech Lake, 14 mi E of Walker; 44 sites with electricity, showers, RV dump, boat access, swimming beach. Reopening ~July 1, 2026 after construction. Walker Ranger District. --Claude Rechecked 2026-09-30: reopened July 2, 2026 (recreation.gov bookable through Sept 19, then seasonal close). --Claude

name: Adams City Park and Campground
note: City of Adams park campground, 14 sites with water and electric hookups, sewer dump station near park entrance; first-come, first-served honor-system self-pay (envelope drop). Restroom/shower building rebuilt 2022. --Claude

name: Anderson Park (Jackson County)
note: Jackson County park on the west shore of Pearl Lake; ~25-36 sites including ~4 lakefront, electric available, restrooms, boat ramp, dock, observation tower. Reservable online (some FCFS/monthly). --Claude

name: Bass Lake County Park & Campground (Itasca County)
note: Itasca County Land Department park on Bass Lake, 11 miles east of Effie, with electric sites in A Loop, non-electric ones in B Loop and 6 tent-only sites, each with a picnic table and fire grate.  Sites 15B and 16B are first-come, first-served, paid at the pay boxes. --Claude

name: Berglund Park Campground
note: Aitkin County Land Department park on the Mississippi River in Palisade (510 Marconi St); 9 sites all with 20/30/50-amp electric, flush toilets, showers, boat access, fishing pier, dump/ATV-wash station. Reserve online 7 days ahead else FCFS self-pay. --Claude

name: Harmony City Campground
note: City of Harmony campground off Hwy 52 on the Harmony-Preston Valley State Trail. Sites 1-6 have electric + water, primitive/tent sites, dump station; first-come, first-served, honor-system pay. --Claude

name: Island View Campground
note: City of Mountain Lake campground near Mountain Lake, the golf course and bike trail. 18 RV pull-through sites with electric/water/sewer, fire rings, new bathroom/showers; first-come first-served (no reservations), open May 1-Oct 1. --Claude

name: Diamond Lake County Park (Kandiyohi County Park 3)
note: Kandiyohi County park on the west shore of Diamond Lake; ~60 campsites with electric, swimming beach, dump station and shelter. County takes reservations only for stays of 7+ nights; shorter stays first-come, first-served. Open May-Sept. --Claude

name: Green Lake County Park (Kandiyohi County Park 5)
note: Kandiyohi County park on the NE shore of Green Lake; 61 sites - 54 full-hookup RV (water/30-50amp/sewer) plus 7 electric tent sites, swimming beach, camp store, showers. Reservable online (7+ night reservations; shorter stays FCFS). --Claude

name: Games Lake County Park (Kandiyohi County Park 7)
note: Kandiyohi County park on the east shore of Games Lake; 56 wooded campsites (full hookups available) plus 5 camper cabins, swimming beach, showers. County takes 7+ night reservations; shorter stays FCFS. --Claude

name: Karlstad Moose Park Campground
note: City of Karlstad municipal campground in Moose Park; 16 sites with 30-amp electric + water, dump station, restrooms, playground, disc golf. First-come, first-served (~$12). --Claude

name: Lake Allie County Park
note: Renville County park on the west shore of Lake Allie; 16 RV sites with water + electric, dump station, fishing pier, swimming. Reservations require 5+ days notice, otherwise first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Lake Hanska County Park
note: Brown County park on Lake Hanska, ~17 mi SW of New Ulm; level electric campsites plus a large tent area, showers, dump, swimming beach, fishing pier. 5 sites reservable (up to 4 months ahead); rest first-come, first-served. Open mid-May-late Sept. --Claude

name: Garvin County Park
note: Lyon County park in bur-oak woodlands along the Cottonwood River, ~13 mi S of Marshall; Lower & Upper campgrounds with 52 electric + 8 non-electric sites (plus a separate 22-site horse campground), showers, dump. Some sites reservable, rest first-come, first-served. Season mid-May-mid-Oct. --Claude

name: Twin Lakes County Park
note: Lyon County park on the neck between East & West Twin Lakes; 2 loops (North 15 electric sites, South 14 electric sites) with dump station, shower house, flush toilets. ~7 sites per loop reservable online, remainder first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Magnolia City Campground
note: Small City of Magnolia park; 10 full-hookup (W/E/S, 30amp) back-in sites plus grassy tent area; clean restrooms/showers, dump station, playground/tennis/basketball. First-come, first-served honor-system payment, $20. --Claude

name: Seven Mile Lake Park
note: Murray County park on the west side of Fulda First Lake within Fulda (900 S Lafayette Ave). 14 drive-in camp sites (first-come, first-served, pay on arrival) plus 5 long-term seasonal sites; restrooms with showers, sand swim beach, boat landing, picnic shelters, playground. Open May-Sep, 14-day max. --Claude

name: Zumbrota Covered Bridge Park
note: City of Zumbrota 80-acre park along the Zumbro River. RV/camper sites with water+electric and water/electric/sewer, grass sites with utility posts; tent sites $25. First-come, first-served, open ~May 15-Nov 1. --Claude

name: Hartford Beach State Park
note: State park on the west shore of Big Stone Lake near Corona. 87 sites across east and west campgrounds; 85 have electric (no water hookups), and 84 sites fit rigs 32-70 ft. Reservable online (up to 3 months out) or FCFS. --Claude

name: Fisher Grove State Park
note: GFP state park on the James River near Frankfort. 22 sites with 30/50-amp electric on paved roads with gravel pads (mostly back-in, a few pull-through), dump/fill station, playground, historic river crossing. Reservable online (no FCFS). --Claude

name: North Wheeler Recreation Area
note: GFP state rec area on Lake Francis Case, ~16 mi S of Platte off SD-1804. 25 electric sites (50/30/20-amp) on gravel pads along the shore, vault toilets, boat ramp, fish-cleaning station; accommodates RVs up to ~65 ft. All sites first-come, first-served. --Claude

name: Little Moreau Recreation Area
note: SD GFP prairie recreation area on the Little Moreau reservoir, 6 mi S of Timber Lake. 5 primitive drive-in campsites (no hookups) on a first-come, first-served basis, plus two 50-amp RV hookup pull-offs bookable through the City of Timber Lake; vault toilets, boat ramp, dump. --Claude

name: Okobojo Point Recreation Area
note: South Dakota GFP recreation area on a peninsula in Lake Oahe, 17 mi NW of Pierre off SD-1804. 18 non-electrical drive-in campsites, first-come, first-served with on-site self-registration. Boat launch at the southern tip near the RV sites; ~2 mi of walking trails. Open year-round; showers/flush toilets/water systems closed Oct 1-Apr 30. --Claude

name: Buffalo Gap National Grasslands - Nomad View Dispersed Camping
note: Dispersed boondocking area on a Buffalo Gap National Grassland ridge ~6 mi S of Wall off Hwy 240, overlooking Badlands NP. ~20 designated gravel sites, no water/toilets/hookups, no campfires; dirt-gravel access passable by normal vehicles (not lowrider/sports-car). First-come, first-served, 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Reva Gap Campground
note: Custer Gallatin NF (Sioux Ranger District) campground in the Slim Buttes/Castles area of NW South Dakota, ~20 mi SE of Buffalo off SD-20. 8 individual sites (plus 2 group), fire ring + picnic table each, ADA vault toilets; NO potable water, no trash. Gravel/dirt spurs average 30-60 ft. First-come, first-served, 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Dutchman Campground (Deerfield Reservoir)
note: Most RV-friendly of the three Deerfield Reservoir campgrounds (the RV Life 'Deerfield Reservoir Complex' also includes Whitetail and Custer Trail). Dutchman has 45 single-family sites (34 reservable via Recreation.gov, 11 FCFS) on the NE edge of Deerfield Reservoir in ponderosa pine; no hookups, vault toilets, drinking water. High-country mountain reservoir (~5,900 ft). --Claude

name: Picnic Spring Campground
note: Custer Gallatin NF (Sioux Ranger District), North Cave Hills near Ludlow. 8 primitive drive-in sites with picnic tables and 2 vault toilets, no hookups; an untreated water source is available (treat before use). Reached via ~7 mi of maintained gravel road. First-come first-served, 14-day limit. --Claude

name: Whitetail Campground (Deerfield Reservoir)
note: Black Hills NF (Mystic RD) above Deerfield Reservoir at ~6,000 ft; ~12 non-electric sites for tents/trailers/RVs (several with lake views; lake access within walking distance), drinking water and vault toilets, no hookups. Sites accommodate RVs to ~76 ft. Reservable on Recreation.gov with some first-come first-served sites. --Claude

name: Black Fox Campground
note: Small 9-site first-come, first-served Black Hills NF campground in a remote spruce forest on South Fork Rapid Creek (Central Hills, ~west of Rapid City). Vault toilets, no potable water (bring your own). Max RV/spur length listed at 45 ft. Free off-season; access road closed to wheeled vehicles Dec 15-Mar 31 for snowmobile use. --Claude

name: Dalton Lake Campground
note: 11-site first-come, first-served Black Hills NF campground beside small Dalton Lake in ponderosa pine, northern Black Hills near Nemo (FSR 26 Vanocker Canyon Rd, then FSR 224/Dalton Lake Rd). Gravel parking aprons ~12x40 ft (45-ft spur length), vault toilet. Fishing, hiking, biking; closes Sept 30. --Claude

name: French Creek Campground
note: Small developed campground in Buffalo Gap National Grassland (Nebraska NF & Grasslands, Fall River Ranger District), ~11 mi east of Fairburn on French Creek Rd then FSR 7055. 7 sites with ramadas, picnic tables, grills, fire pits; vault toilet, no potable water. Wide roads and a large mowed area for RVs/trailers make it drive-in RV friendly; popular base for the Fairburn Agate Beds. Roads can be difficult when wet. Open year-round, first-come, first-served. This is the grassland campground, NOT the Custer State Park French Creek hike-in natural area or the horse camp. --Claude
